logline: Two Incheon detectives - one a streetwise veteran who bends rules, the other a by-the-book analyst - are forced to partner up and find that every major crime leads back to a corruption they cannot outrun.

renewal.note: Two seasons aired on JTBC: Season 1 in summer 2020, Season 2 in summer 2022. No further renewal announced.

bollymeter.basis: Audience reception was strong enough to double viewership ratings from premiere to finale on JTBC. Critics at HelloKPop highlighted the simple yet engrossing storytelling and a nicely balanced blend of crime, drama and comedy. IMDb audiences rate it 7.6.

pull_quotes.text: Simple yet engrossing storytelling with nicely-incorporated drama, comedy and thrilling notes.

seasons.review_body: Written by Choi Jin-won and directed by Jo Nam-gook, Season 1 of The Good Detective aired on JTBC's prime Monday-Tuesday slot from July to August 2020. The drama built its audience steadily - viewership ratings doubled between the first and last episodes, a metric that signals genuine word-of-mouth traction in Korean broadcast. Critics pointed to the odd-couple chemistry between Son Hyun-joo's rough-edged veteran Kang Do-chang and Jang Seung-jo's evidence-driven Oh Ji-hyuk as the engine that keeps 16 episodes moving. The show is fundamentally a crime procedural but layers its case-of-the-week structure with ongoing institutional corruption, making each solved case feel like a smaller battle inside a larger unwinnable war. Reviewers found the middle episodes slower but praised both leads' performances and the sharp writing in the final stretch.

episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The first episode establishes the partnership dynamic cleanly - two men who should not work together, thrown together by circumstance, circling a case that is bigger than either of them knows.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The scene where Do-chang's instinct-based hunch and Ji-hyuk's forensic read arrive at the same answer from opposite directions.

bollymeter.basis: Season 2 returned the core pairing with new cast additions but reviews suggested slightly diminished urgency compared to the debut season's tighter corruption arc.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 brought back Son Hyun-joo and Jang Seung-jo with new colleagues and a fresh corruption case set against Incheon's power structures. The JTBC return aired from July to September 2022 across 16 episodes. Audience reception was broadly positive - the pairing that made Season 1 work still functions, and the procedural-plus-conspiracy structure that distinguishes the show from standard K-crime formats carries over intact. The second season lacks the revelatory freshness of the debut but delivers reliable, well-crafted crime drama for viewers already invested in the characters.
seasons.season_over_season: The core buddy dynamic carries over intact, but Season 2 lacks the first season's element of surprise - the corruption formula is now expected rather than revelatory.
